definitions.explanation: The main character or leading actor in a play, film, or story.
Figuratively, the most important person in a situation or event.

examples.japanese: この{映画|えいが}で{主役|しゅやく}を{演|えん}じた。
examples.english: I played the leading role in this movie.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{主役|しゅやく}は{誕生日|たんじょうび}の{彼女|かのじょ}だ。
examples.english: Today's star is the birthday girl.

examples.japanese: {主役|しゅやく}のオーディションを{受|う}けた。
examples.english: I auditioned for the lead role.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{主役|しゅやく}を{演|えん}じる (to play the lead role)
・{主役|しゅやく}を{務|つと}める (to serve as the lead)
・{主役|しゅやく}になる (to become the main character/central figure)
・{主役|しゅやく}を{張|は}る (to take the lead role)

OPPOSITE:
・{脇役|わきやく} - supporting role, supporting actor
・{端役|はやく} - minor role, bit part

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{主人公|しゅじんこう} - protagonist, main character (of a story)

[Register: Neutral]
